text:
Ana: Quick PR up to clarify per-tier billing examples and update the SDK snippet for `quota_limits` response shape. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4930

Peter: Can you include a tiny numeric example for 3 tiers (free, pro, enterprise) showing base/burst/effective? Folks expect copy-paste numbers.

Ana: Done in the migration section: free: base 10k, burst 2k -> eff 12k; pro: base 100k, burst 25k -> eff 125k; enterprise: base 1M, burst 200k -> eff 1.2M. Also switched all snippets to client.v2.

DocsBot: link-checker: 0 broken links. markdown-lint: minor wrap warning.

Peter: Nice. One tiny ask: add a one-liner showing alert expression we recommend: `sum(increase(usage_tokens_total[5m])) by (tier) / quota_limits_effective > 0.9 for 10m`.

Ana: Added alert snippet and a short note about burst exhaustion causing transient >1.0 ratios. Merging after CI green.

Peter: LGTM :thumbsup:
